recommendations_catalog.title: Digital Payments Integration
recommendations_catalog.problem: Manual cash transactions and delayed payments slow down checkout and increase accounting errors.
recommendations_catalog.solution: Deploy integrated UPI QR codes, POS machine, and automatic payment link notifications.
recommendations_catalog.expected_benefit: Accelerates customer checkout by 60% and eliminates cash handling errors.

recommendations_catalog.title: Digital Inventory Management
recommendations_catalog.problem: Manual Excel or notebook stock tracking leads to out-of-stock items and over-purchasing slow-moving goods.
recommendations_catalog.solution: Implement a cloud-based inventory app (e.g. Vyapar/Khatabook/Zoho Inventory) with barcode scanning.
recommendations_catalog.expected_benefit: Reduces inventory stockouts by 45% and automates low-stock alerts.

recommendations_catalog.title: WhatsApp Commerce & Online Catalog
recommendations_catalog.problem: Customers cannot browse products remotely, missing out on weekend and local delivery sales.
recommendations_catalog.solution: Create a WhatsApp Business digital catalog and mini e-commerce webpage.
recommendations_catalog.expected_benefit: Expands local customer reach and generates 25-35% additional monthly digital orders.

recommendations_catalog.title: Targeted Social Media & Festival Marketing
recommendations_catalog.problem: Relying purely on foot traffic limits brand awareness to immediate physical neighbors.
recommendations_catalog.solution: Launch Instagram & Google Business profile with weekly product showcases and local targeted ads.
recommendations_catalog.expected_benefit: Drives 50+ new store visits per month and builds brand recognition in Roorkee.

recommendations_catalog.title: Customer Analytics & CRM Insights
recommendations_catalog.problem: No insights on top repeat buyers, purchase frequencies, or fast-selling product categories.
recommendations_catalog.solution: Use simple CRM tracking to log purchase history and send personalized WhatsApp promotion offers.
recommendations_catalog.expected_benefit: Increases repeat customer retention rate by up to 30%.
